entities.name: NOTIFICATION RESPONSE
entities.description: A 5GS mobility management message used to respond to a NOTIFICATION message from the network.

entities.name: Extended protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol being used, mandatory in the NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Indicates the type of security applied to the message, mandatory in the NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message.

entities.name: Spare half octet
entities.description: A spare half octet used for alignment, mandatory in the NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message.

entities.name: Notification response message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message as a NOTIFICATION RESPONSE, mandatory in the message.

entities.name: PDU session status
entities.description: Indicates the status of PDU sessions, optional in the NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message.

relations.description: The NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message contains the Extended protocol discriminator IE.
The NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message contains the Security header type IE.
The NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message contains the Spare half octet IE.
The NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message contains the Notification response message identity IE.
The NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message optionally contains the PDU session status IE.
